name: Slaughter Hollow
summary: In the snowy heights of the Alterac Mountains, Crushridge ogres hold Slaughter Hollow as a secluded camp. Travelers rarely come here except to hunt ogres or cross the frozen passes.

sections.title: A Den of Ogres
sections.body: Slaughter Hollow shelters the Crushridge ogres high in the peaks between Hillsbrad and Alterac. Makeshift fires, scattered bones, and crude shelters mark the mound. Other ogre dens in the highlands often see fights over territory or stolen supplies, but Slaughter Hollow stays quiet and beyond the reach of major military campaigns.

sections.title: Captives and Travelers
sections.body: Crushridge ogres sometimes keep prisoners taken along the mountain trails in their secluded mound. Travelers speak of Rizz Loosebolt, an unlucky gnome locked in a crude cage and trying to bargain with anyone who passes. Captives seldom fare well against the clan's appetite.

faq.answer: Crushridge ogres keep an encampment in Slaughter Hollow, high in the Alterac Mountains. Crude shelters and fires mark their mound.
Crushridge ogres live in Slaughter Hollow. The clan also holds the nearby ruins of Alterac City and outposts in the surrounding lands.
No formal assignments send travelers directly to Slaughter Hollow. The den lies out of the way, among the mountain paths.

faq.q: Who was the gnome caged here?
faq.answer: Rizz Loosebolt, a gnome, is held in a cage inside Slaughter Hollow and offers wares to anyone who finds him.

angles.text: As a gnome, Rizz Loosebolt's capture by the Crushridge is a warning to tinkerers and scouts who cross the Alterac passes unprepared.
